items.title: Plugins share a setting
items.text: Plugins from the same marketplace can share a value, like a project code, so you set it once for all of them.

items.title: Safer plugin installs
items.text: A plugin can add to your Claude Code only the one plugin its install sheet names, nothing else.

items.title: Widgets name the right page
items.text: A widget on a thread's Brief or a client's Overview now shows that thread or client in its header.

items.title: One filter for a whole dashboard
items.text: Add Filters to Today and set the period, thread or client once for every widget beside it.

items.title: Export a dashboard
items.text: Export, beside ✎, saves the page as one HTML file that opens anywhere.

items.title: Pages use the full width
items.text: Brief, Overview and dashboards now fill the window, and long text stays easy to read.

items.title: Plugin links open on one click
items.text: A plugin's web link opens on the first click, and its address shows when you point at it.
